# Scripts

Where a script runs decides what it can see. Every script also gets the [globals](index.md#globals). A centity, a menu, a dialog, an item and a block each have at most one script, and its own handle is `this`; a slot or a button is `this:slot(index)` or `this:button(key)`. A script can `require` more `.lua` files beside it, which run as part of it, with the same `this`. A script's body runs every time it starts, and that's where it registers its handlers: see [Events](events.md).

A script the editor creates starts with a line like `local this = this --[[@as Centity]]`, which tells the editor (and lua-language-server) which kind of `this` it is, so completions are right.

## Centity scripts

A centity's script (`centities/<id>/*.lua`, named by `script` in `centity.json`). One copy runs per spawned instance, with its own globals; `this` is the instance. The script's body runs every time it starts (spawning, a restart, a reload): that's where it sets up its nodes and registers its handlers, with `this:on(...)` and `this:node(name):on(...)`.

| Global | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `this` | [`Centity`](centity.md) | The centity instance this script runs on. |

## Module scripts

A module's files (`modules/<id>/**/*.lua`). `init.lua` runs when the server loads the module; other files run when something requires them. All of a module's files share one set of globals. Modules listen with `nf.on` (and `:on` on any handle they hold) and add commands with `nf.commands.register`.

## Menu scripts

A menu's script (`menus/<id>/*.lua`, named by `script` in `menu.json`). Every window gets its own copy, with its own globals, started when the window is made: when it's opened for someone, or at load for a `shared` one. The body runs before anyone sees the window, so it's where to fill it in and register handlers (`this:on("click", ...)`, `this:slot(13):on("click", ...)`). Its handlers go with the window.

| Global | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `this` | [`Menu`](menu.md) | The window this script runs for. |

## Dialog scripts

A dialog's script (`dialogs/<id>/*.lua`, named by `script` in `dialog.json`). There's one of each dialog, so its script runs once, from load until the dialog is reloaded. Its body registers handlers: `this:on("press", ...)`, `this:button(key):on("press", ...)`, `this:on("close", ...)`.

| Global | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `this` | [`Dialog`](dialog.md) | The dialog this script belongs to. |

## Item scripts

A project item's script (`items/<id>/*.lua`, named by `script` in `item.json`). There's one of each item, so its script runs once (not once per stack), from load until the item is reloaded. Its body registers handlers for what players do with any stack of the item: `this:on("use", ...)`, `this:on("hit", ...)`, `this:on("pickup", ...)`.

| Global | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `this` | [`ProjectItem`](projectitem.md) | The project item this script belongs to. |

## Block scripts

A project block's script (`blocks/<id>/*.lua`, named by `script` in `block.json`). There's one of each block, so its script runs once (not once per placed block), from load until the block is reloaded. Its body registers handlers for what players do with any block of it: `this:on("click", ...)`, `this:on("break", ...)`, `this:on("tick", ...)`.

| Global | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `this` | [`ProjectBlock`](projectblock.md) | The project block this script belongs to. |

## Screen scripts

A screen's script (`screens/<id>/*.lua`, named by `script` in `screen.json`). There's one of each screen, so its script runs once, from load until the screen is reloaded. Its body draws the screen (what a screen shows isn't saved, so this is where it's drawn after every restart) and registers handlers: `this:on("click", ...)`, `this:on("hover", ...)`.

| Global | Type | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `this` | [`Screen`](screen.md) | The screen this script belongs to. |
